tools.description: Make a word search from a word list. Each word is hidden exactly once and the filler letters are checked so they don't spell rude words. tools.name: make_maze
tools.description: Make a maze with exactly one path from Start to Finish, with a picture of the printed page and a link to the print PDF. The answer key page draws the path. Rectangle mazes in small, medium and large are free.

tools.name: make_sudoku
tools.description: Make a page of sudoku, each with exactly one answer, checked by a solver. small is six 4 by 4 grids, medium four 6 by 6 grids, large one 9 by 9. Returns the grids and answers as text, a picture of the page and a link to the print PDF. Pro.

tools.name: list_puzzle_types
tools.description: List every puzzle Recess Puzzles makes, the sizes and levels, and what's free and what needs Pro.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: With a pro_code, says if the code is good. With no code, says what Recess Puzzles Pro adds, what it costs and where to get it. Nothing is bought through this tool.
